title: When One Moment Isn't Enough: Multi-Moment Retrieval with Cross-Moment Interactions

problems.name: Multi-Moment, Compositional, and Complex Query Grounding
problems.evidence_sentence: We introduce FlashMMR, a novel Multi-Moment Retrieval (MMR) framework, which incorporates a Multi-Moment Post-Verification module to refine candidate segments by enforcing temporal consistency across related moments.

problems.name: Dataset, Benchmark, and Evaluation Mismatch
problems.evidence_sentence: By revisiting the gap between current MR tasks and real-world applications, we introduce a high-quality datasets called QVHighlights Multi-Moment Dataset (QV-M$^2$), along with new evaluation metrics tailored for multi-moment retrieval (MMR).

problems.name: Boundary Ambiguity and Localization Precision
problems.evidence_sentence: Beyond dataset contributions, we also propose new evaluation metrics that extend standard mean Average Precision (mAP) and Intersection-over-Union (IoU) to measure MMR performance.

methods.name: Benchmark or Dataset Construction
methods.evidence_sentence: By revisiting the gap between current MR tasks and real-world applications, we introduce a high-quality datasets called QVHighlights Multi-Moment Dataset (QV-M$^2$), along with new evaluation metrics tailored for multi-moment retrieval (MMR).

methods.name: Pretraining, Pseudo-Labeling, and Data Generation
methods.evidence_sentence: To support rigorous benchmarking and further research in this area, we introduce QV-M2 (QVHighlights [12] Multi- Moment Dataset), an enhanced dataset based on QVHighlights.

methods.name: Coarse-to-Fine or Hierarchical Localization
methods.evidence_sentence: Specifically, we propose a Multi-moment Post-verification module to refine the moment boundaries.

methods.name: Contrastive or Cross-Modal Alignment
methods.evidence_sentence: Through this sophisticated filtering pipeline, low-confidence proposals are pruned, and robust multi-moment alignment is achieved.
